title: CAFT λ=0 vs λ=0.5 ρ-difference attribution reframe — fact record (fix-12 audit follow-up)
purpose: Fact record for the Paper 1 narrative rewrite: the 'CAFT partially restores ρ (+0.19..+0.23)' claim is a FAILED CONTROL — the λ=0.5 arm never applied the continuity objective, so the ρ difference between the λ=0 and λ=0.5 groups cannot be attributed to λ. Do NOT re-run or edit any code; this file only records verifiable facts.
verdict: 对照失败 (failed control). 'CAFT ρ=+0.19 恢复' is NOT a causal effect of the CAFT objective; it is run-to-run nondeterminism (bf16 + stochastic data preparation).

runs.note: The 6 locked Paper 1 fine-tuned arms (3 seeds x {naive, caft}).

1_script_identical.finding: All 6 archived caft_gf.py scripts are byte-identical (md5 8241ff23dea92ff1789e23c569108f2a), and identical to the CURRENT scripts/caft_gf.py (md5 8241ff23dea92ff1789e23c569108f2a).

2_source_tokenized_data_identical.finding: The tokenized source h5ad (corneal_layer_subset.h5ad) is byte-identical across runs: md5 9ed5f62704ebf60d591fc685c4fb6642 (verified for lam0.0_s42, lam0.0_s123, lam0.5_s42).

3_prepared_train_datasets_NOT_logically_.finding: CORRECTION to audit report §5.2: the run-local prepared train datasets (79684 cells each) are NOT logically identical. Full-order SHA-256 over (input_ids, length, label) rows differs across all 6 runs. Numeric class-label assignment is permuted run-to-run (e.g. 'pericyte' is class 30 in lam0.0_s42 but class 13 in lam0.5_s42; 31 class names identical, ids permuted) because Classifier.prepare_data -> downsample_and_shuffle -> label_classes assigns ids from the shuffled row order, which varies between runs. This is ADDITIONAL nondeterminism beyond bf16; it makes the two groups even less of a controlled comparison.
3_prepared_train_datasets_NOT_logically_.note_semantics_preserved: Each run's class_to_layer mapping is built from its own id_class_dict (class NAME -> layer), so layer semantics are internally consistent despite the numeric id permutation; only the numeric ids differ.

4_training_config_identical.finding: All 6 runs share identical training configuration (from each run's caft_args.json).

5_L_cont_never_ran.finding: The continuity objective NEVER executed in any of the 6 runs. (a) transformers 4.57 dispatches on_epoch_begin only to registered TrainerCallback objects; CAFTTrainer.on_epoch_begin is a dead Trainer method (no callback ever registered by build_caft_trainer / caft_gf.py). (b) trainer log_history_tail in all 6 caft_args.json contains ONLY the plain 'loss' key — no L_cont / L_cls / caft_loss entries (CAFT compute_loss logs those every 50 steps when the term runs). (c) layer_centroids was never populated -> compute_loss fell back to loss = loss_cls, i.e. the λ=0.5 runs trained PURE cross-entropy, identical objective to λ=0.
5_L_cont_never_ran.continuity_terms_in_logs: NONE in any of the 6 runs

6_rho_group_difference.finding: L12 (final CLS) marker-gradient Spearman rho: naive group {-0.0424, -0.0360, +0.0539} mean -0.0082 vs 'CAFT' group {+0.1913, +0.2298, +0.2095} mean +0.2102. The groups are fully separated (3v3), but since the λ=0.5 group never received the continuity gradient (evidence #5), the difference is NOT a causal effect of λ.
6_rho_group_difference.source: artifacts/paper1_tier_b_eval/percell_*.npz.meta.json sanity_gate_external.rho (== results_*.json marker_gradient_rank_correlation == layerwise L12 rho, all diff=0.0 per fix-12 audit)

7_nondeterminism_explanation.finding: The observed ρ separation is attributable to run-to-run nondeterminism, not λ: (a) bf16 training on GB10 unified memory: fp32 master weights with bf16 autocast forward/backward accumulate rounding error chaotically over 7473 steps (3 epochs x 2491 steps), amplifying tiny per-step differences into different checkpoints; (b) stochastic data preparation (evidence #3): numeric class ids and row order differ run-to-run, so even the training data as fed to the model differs; (c) the final-cls rho is measured on the LAST hidden state, the most collapsed/sensitive layer, where checkpoint differences are largest. The 3v3 separation (Mann-Whitney two-sided p = 0.1 for n=3+3 with complete separation; the audit's 'p≈0.05' is the one-sided value) has no causal interpretation.
7_nondeterminism_explanation.caveat: With only 3 runs per group and a nondeterministic pipeline, no statistical claim of a λ effect is supportable. The honest-negative conclusion (fine-tuning does not preserve the gradient; CAFT as-implemented provides no evidence of restoration) is unchanged.

implications_for_manuscript.do_not_claim: Any wording implying the continuity objective acted on the λ=0.5 checkpoints (e.g. 'CAFT partially restores the gradient', 'the continuity objective acted on a readout already overwritten').
implications_for_manuscript.suggested_framing: The λ=0.5 group's checkpoints show higher L12 rho than λ=0, but the continuity term never ran (dead hook, transformers 4.57); the difference reflects run-to-run nondeterminism, not the CAFT objective. Report as a failed control; the classification-only comparison (no λ effect on macro-F1) stands.
